name: ESC-50: Dataset for Environmental Sound Classification
description: ESC-50 is a labeled collection of 2,000 environmental audio recordings suitable for benchmarking methods of environmental sound classification. It contains 50 semantically distinct categories grouped into 5 major domains: animals, natural soundscapes and water sounds, human non-speech sounds, interior/domestic sounds, and exterior/urban noises. Each class contains 40 five-second audio clips sampled at 44.1 kHz, organized into 5 predefined folds for cross-validation.

provenance.curation_notes: Balanced across 50 categories with exactly 40 clips per category, structured into 5 balanced cross-validation folds.
